description: Extension of ChannelsStore class providing lifecycle management methods such as start, stop, refresh, and specific channel login/logout functionalities for WhatsApp and Telegram within a macOS application.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts polling task for refreshing channel status periodically.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the current status snapshot for channels, with probe option.

methods.name: startWhatsAppLogin
methods.description: Initiates WhatsApp login process, optionally auto-waiting for login confirmation.

methods.name: waitWhatsAppLogin
methods.description: Waits for WhatsApp login process to complete within a timeout.

methods.name: logoutWhatsApp
methods.description: Logs out and clears WhatsApp session and credentials.

methods.name: logoutTelegram
methods.description: Logs out and clears Telegram session.
